sourceTitle: Northern Lands; Or, Young America in Russia and Prussia
description: "Northern Lands; Or, Young America in Russia and Prussia" by Oliver Optic is a historical account and adventure story written in the late 19th century. The book focuses on the experiences of a group of young American tourists aboard the Academy Squadron as they travel through the Baltic region, exploring the cultural landscape of Russia and Prussia.
